title: Ship the Watchlist
prompt: Put these steps in order: from a working app on your laptop to a live production site, then shipping one more change safely through a preview deployment.
hints: Check the production build on your own machine before anything leaves it.
Vercel imports a repository, so the code has to be on GitHub first.
A change on a branch gets a preview URL; production only changes when main does.
explanation: You verify the real build locally with `npm run build` and `npm run preview`, commit, and push to GitHub so Vercel has a repository to import. Importing detects Vite (`vite build`, output `dist`), and the first deploy gives you a production URL. After that, changes go on a branch: the pull request gets its own preview URL to check, and merging into `main` triggers the production deployment.

items.build-preview: Run `npm run build` and `npm run preview` and click through the app locally
items.commit: Commit the working app with Git
items.push: Create a GitHub repository and `git push -u origin main`
items.import: In Vercel, Add New → Project and import the repository (preset: Vite, output: dist)
items.deploy: Click Deploy and open the production URL on your phone
items.branch-preview: Restyle the filter bar on a branch, open a pull request and check its preview URL
items.merge: Merge the pull request into main so production updates
